_comment: Performance baseline for SorobanPay SubscriptionProtocol — TEST-100 / SC-23 / Issue #1426.
_comment2: Update via: node scripts/load-test-batch-execute.mjs (from project root, requires live testnet access).
_comment3: Regression threshold: 20%. CI fails if any metric exceeds baseline * 1.20.

subscribe._comment: Pure write: 1 require_auth + 5 validations + 1 persistent write + 1 TTL extend + 1 event publish.
subscribe._comment2: No cross-contract calls. Cost: ~50k–150k instructions (README guidance).

execute_payment._comment: Highest cost: 1 require_auth + 1 storage read + 1 timestamp read + 2 cross-contract calls (balance + transfer) + 1 storage write + 1 TTL extend + 1 event publish.
execute_payment._comment2: Two cross-contract calls (especially transfer) dominate. Cost: ~500k instructions (README guidance).

cancel._comment: Lowest cost: 1 require_auth + 1 storage has check + 1 storage remove + 1 event publish.
cancel._comment2: No cross-contract calls, no write to new keys. Cost: ~50k instructions (README guidance).

batch_execute_payment._comment: Load test: batch of 50 subscribers — Issue #1426.
batch_execute_payment._comment2: Method: linear-projection from execute_payment baseline (conservative upper bound). Run scripts/load-test-batch-execute.mjs against testnet for live simulation values.
batch_execute_payment._comment3: Soroban hard limits: 100M instructions, 512KB readBytes, 64KB writeBytes. All projections are within limits.
batch_execute_payment._comment4: Live simulation will be cheaper: auth and ledger-entry reads are partially amortised across the batch.
notes: Linear projection from single execute_payment baseline — conservative upper bound.
Actual batch cost is lower: merchant auth is verified once; storage reads are partially cached within the Soroban host across loop iterations.
Run `node scripts/load-test-batch-execute.mjs` against testnet to get live simulation values.
Set CONTRACT_ID env var to the deployed contract address before running.
Set SIMULATE_ONLY=false and MERCHANT_SECRET=S... to submit a real transaction.
